development.interpretation: PR74 and PR76 clouds reused for development. No independent claim on those data.

calibration_rule.scope: Per model: both arms, all intervals, Gram entries and nonempty blocks of a new accepted cloud. No simultaneous claim across the two models.

paired_test_comparison.metric: Mean absolute log second moment of focus-block standardized means, across both arms.
paired_test_comparison.interpretation: Prespecified paired cloud bootstrap; approximate pilot evidence, not an exact finite-sample test.

interpretation: Marginal invariant prediction sets and working second-moment shape; no conditional coordinate covariance, production correction or 4D transfer.
